"); animation: flapRight2 .23s ease-in-out infinite; }

.p1 { width:20px;height:18px;left:12%;top:19%;background-image:url("data:image/png;base64,");animation:petalFloat1 11s linear infinite; }
.p2 { width:17px;height:15px;left:76%;top:23%;background-image:url("data:image/png;base64,");animation:petalFloat2 13s linear infinite 1.8s; }
.p3 { width:22px;height:19px;left:8%;top:49%;background-image:url("data:image/png;base64,");animation:petalFloat3 12s linear infinite 4s; }
.p4 { width:16px;height:14px;left:83%;top:48%;background-image:url("data:image/png;base64,");animation:petalFloat4 14s linear infinite 2.2s; }
.p5 { width:19px;height:17px;left:24%;top:67%;background-image:url("data:image/png;base64,");animation:petalFloat5 10.5s linear infinite 3.4s; }
.p6 { width:14px;height:13px;left:70%;top:72%;background-image:url("data:image/png;base64,");animation:petalFloat6 12.5s linear infinite 5.5s; }

.app {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 8;
  width: min(100%, 920px);
  min-height: 100vh;
  margin: 0 auto;
  padding: 14px 10px 30px;
}

.top {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 48px 1fr 48px;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  position: relative;
  z-index: 14;
}

.icon-btn {
  width: 44px;
  height: 44px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 2px solid rgba(216, 183, 111, .92);
  background: var(--accent-deep);
  color: #fff8e7;
  font-size: 20px;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.22);
}

.title-wrap {
  text-align: center;
  padding-top: 2px;
}

.title {
  color: var(--accent-deep);
  font-size: clamp(24px, 5vw, 46px);
  line-height: .96;
  font-weight: 700;
  text-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.8);
}

.cute {
  margin-top: 5px;
  color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 72%, #9a6a1e);
  font-family: "Segoe Script", "Brush Script MT", cursive;
  font-size: clamp(16px, 3vw, 28px);
  text-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.45);
}

.scene {
  min-height: calc(100vh - 100px);
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  position: relative;
  z-index: 10;
  padding: 52px 0 20px;
}

.result-pill {
  position: absolute;
  left: 50%;
  top: 10px;
  transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(-4px);
  z-index: 18;
  min-width: 220px;
  max-width: min(84vw, 440px);
  padding: 10px 18px 11px;
  border-radius: 24px;
  border: 2px solid #cda35a;
  background: linear-gradient(#fff7e8, #ead4ae);
  box-shadow: 0 10px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.20);
  text-align: center;
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  transition: opacity .3s ease, transform .3s ease;
}

.result-pill.show {
  opacity: 1;
  transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0);
}

.result-pill small {
  display: block;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-style: italic;
  color: #34281a;
}

.result-pill strong {
  display: block;
  margin-top: 2px;
  color: var(--accent-deep);
  font-size: clamp(22px, 4vw, 32px);
  letter-spacing: .08em;
}

.table-shell {
  position: relative;
  width: min(72vw, 590px);
  aspect-ratio: 1;
  margin: 0;
  touch-action: none;
  user-select: none;
  cursor: grab;
}

.table-shell.dragging {
  cursor: grabbing;
}

.table {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 13px solid #4b2f1d;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at center, #31563f 0 16%, transparent 16.5%),
    radial-gradient(circle at center, transparent 0 58%, rgba(234,199,126,.32) 58.2% 59%, transparent 59.5%),
    repeating-conic-gradient(from 0deg, rgba(255,230,171,.08) 0deg 2deg, transparent 2deg 12deg),
    radial-gradient(circle, #875b39, #684128 69%, #41281a);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 0 0 4px #ad7a48,
    inset 0 0 36px rgba(0,0,0,.55),
    0 24px 48px rgba(0,0,0,.30);
  transform: rotate(var(--table-rotation));
  transition: transform 1s cubic-bezier(.2,.84,.2,1);
}

.table-shell.dragging .table {
  transition: none;
}

.table::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 8.3%;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 1px solid rgba(241,215,156,.35);
  box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 24px rgba(39,78,54,.07);
}

.center-ring {
  position: absolute;
  left: 50%;
  top: 50%;
  width: 35%;
  aspect-ratio: 1;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 7px solid #6f482a;
  background: radial-gradient(circle at 48% 42%, #3b6449, #213d2e 72%);
  box-shadow:
    inset 0 0 0 2px #bc8e56,
    inset 0 0 28px rgba(0,0,0,.42);
  z-index: 2;
}

.deck {
  position: absolute;
  left: var(--x);
  top: var(--y);
  width: 21%;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%) rotate(var(--face));
  z-index: 7;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: opacity .45s ease, filter .45s ease;
}

.deck-card {
  width: 100%;
  aspect-ratio: .73;
  border-radius: 16px;
  border: 2px solid rgba(80, 55, 33, .38);
  box-shadow: 0 11px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.28);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  gap: 8px;
  position: relative;
  transition: transform .75s cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.2,1), box-shadow .45s ease;
}

.deck-card::before {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 5px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(72,49,27,.22);
  border-radius: 10px;
}

.deck-card::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  left: 6%;
  right: 6%;
  bottom: -9px;
  height: 9px;
  border-radius: 0 0 10px 10px;
  background: rgba(62,44,29,.25);
  box-shadow: 0 4px rgba(62,44,29,.16), 0 8px rgba(62,44,29,.10);
}

.deck-icon {
  width: 44%;
  aspect-ratio: 1;
  position: relative;
}

.deck-name {
  font-size: clamp(16px, 2.5vw, 25px);
  font-weight: 700;
}

.icon-roots::before,
.icon-roots::after,
.icon-field::before,
.icon-field::after,
.icon-garden::before,
.icon-garden::after,
.icon-vine::before,
.icon-vine::after,
.icon-seasons::before,
.icon-seasons::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  background: currentColor;
  opacity: .72;
}

.icon-roots::before {
  left: 42%;
  top: 0;
  width: 16%;
  height: 48%;
  border-radius: 30% 30% 15% 15%;
}

.icon-roots::after {
  left: 14%;
  top: 36%;
  width: 72%;
  height: 44%;
  background:
    linear-gradient(25deg, transparent 46%, currentColor 47% 53%, transparent 54%),
    linear-gradient(-25deg, transparent 46%, currentColor 47% 53%, transparent 54%),
    linear-gradient(0deg, transparent 46%, currentColor 47% 53%, transparent 54%);
}

.icon-field::before {
  left: 46%;
  top: 8%;
  width: 8%;
  height: 82%;
  border-radius: 8px;
}

.icon-field::after {
  left: 20%;
  top: 18%;
  width: 60%;
  height: 60%;
  background:
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 35% 20%, currentColor 0 16%, transparent 17%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 65% 32%, currentColor 0 16%, transparent 17%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 35% 48%, currentColor 0 16%, transparent 17%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 65% 60%, currentColor 0 16%, transparent 17%);
}

.icon-garden::before {
  left: 31%;
  top: 17%;
  width: 38%;
  height: 38%;
  border-radius: 50%;
  box-shadow:
    0 -18px 0 -7px currentColor,
    0 18px 0 -7px currentColor,
    18px 0 0 -7px currentColor,
    -18px 0 0 -7px currentColor;
}

.icon-garden::after {
  left: 47%;
  top: 53%;
  width: 7%;
  height: 36%;
  border-radius: 8px;
}

.icon-vine::before {
  left: 28%;
  top: 15%;
  width: 44%;
  height: 60%;
  border: 5px solid currentColor;
  border-left-color: transparent;
  border-bottom-color: transparent;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: transparent;
  transform: rotate(25deg);
}

.icon-vine::after {
  left: 25%;
  top: 38%;
  width: 52%;
  height: 52%;
  background:
    radial-gradient(circle at 35% 25%, currentColor 0 13%, transparent 14%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 60% 30%, currentColor 0 13%, transparent 14%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 46% 50%, currentColor 0 13%, transparent 14%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 31% 65%, currentColor 0 13%, transparent 14%),
    radial-gradient(circle at 60% 68%, currentColor 0 13%, transparent 14%);
}

.icon-seasons::before {
  left: 16%;
  top: 45%;
  width: 68%;
  height: 6%;
  border-radius: 8px;
  box-shadow: 0 -18px 0 0 currentColor, 0 18px 0 0 currentColor;
}

.icon-seasons::after {
  left: 47%;
  top: 14%;
  width: 6%;
  height: 72%;
  border-radius: 8px;
  box-shadow: -18px 0 0 0 currentColor, 18px 0 0 0 currentColor;
}

.roots .deck-card {
  background: linear-gradient(150deg, #fbf5e7, #d9dcc5);
  color: #34432e;
}

.field .deck-card {
  background: linear-gradient(150deg, #f9e9ba, #d8b35c);
  color: #694b1c;
}

.garden .deck-card {
  background: linear-gradient(150deg, #fae0e8, #d696a9);
  color: #6e3547;
}

.vine .deck-card {
  background: linear-gradient(150deg, #e6e8d4, #9eaa82);
  color: #3d4b30;
}

.seasons .deck-card {
  background: linear-gradient(150deg, #edf3f5, #a5bbca);
  color: #345568;
}

.table.has-selection .deck:not(.selected) {
  opacity: .57;
  filter: saturate(.78) brightness(.90);
}

.deck.selected {
  z-index: 14;
}

.deck.selected .deck-card {
  transform: translateY(7px) scale(1.18);
  box-shadow:
    0 0 0 4px rgba(255,223,137,.68),
    0 0 28px rgba(255,194,72,.55),
    0 22px 36px rgba(0,0,0,.34);
}

.die-hit {
  position: absolute;
  left: 50%;
  top: 50%;
  width: 96px;
  height: 96px;
  transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
  z-index: 16;
  cursor: pointer;
  touch-action: manipulation;
}

#diceCanvas {
  width: 100%;
  height: 100%;
  display: block;
}

.question-layer {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: 40;
  display: none;
  place-items: center;
  padding: 20px;
  background: rgba(17, 25, 18, .60);
  backdrop-filter: blur(8px);
}

.question-layer.show {
  display: grid;
}

.question-card {
  width: min(92vw, 560px);
  min-height: 390px;
  padding: 34px;
  border-radius: 28px;
  border: 3px solid #d4b36a;
  background: linear-gradient(150deg, #fff9ee, #eadabe);
  box-shadow: 0 28px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.44);
  text-align: center;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}

.qcat {
  color: var(--accent);
  font: 700 14px system-ui, sans-serif;
  letter-spacing: .16em;
}

.qtext {
  font-size: clamp(24px, 5vw, 38px);
  line-height: 1.24;
  margin: 22px 0 28px;
}

.done {
  border: 0;
  border-radius: 999px;
  padding: 13px 23px;
  background: var(--accent-deep);
  color: #fff7df;
  font: 700 18px Georgia, serif;
  cursor: pointer;
}

@keyframes rootsBreathe { 0%,100%{transform:translate3d(0,0,0) scale(1.003)} 50%{transform:translate3d(2px,-2px,0) scale(1.008)} }
@keyframes fieldSway { 0%,100%{transform:translate3d(-2px,0,0) rotate(-.18deg) scale(1.004)} 50%{transform:translate3d(4px,-1px,0) rotate(.24deg) scale(1.009)} }
@keyframes vineSway { 0%,100%{transform:translate3d(-2px,0,0) rotate(-.22deg) scale(1.006)} 50%{transform:translate3d(3px,-2px,0) rotate(.28deg) scale(1.012)} }
@keyframes seasonsDrift { 0%,100%{transform:translate3d(0,1px,0) scale(1.004)} 50%{transform:translate3d(2px,-3px,0) scale(1.009)} }

@keyframes swayCanopy {
  0%,100% { transform: translateX(0) rotate(-0.5deg) scale(1.002); }
  50% { transform: translateX(3px) rotate(0.6deg) scale(1.004); }
}

@keyframes flapLeft1 {
  0%,100% { transform: perspective(180px) rotateY(0deg) rotate(-4deg); }
  50% { transform: perspective(180px) rotateY(76deg) rotate(11deg) translateY(-1px); }
}
@keyframes flapRight1 {
  0%,100% { transform: perspective(180px) rotateY(0deg) rotate(4deg); }
  50% { transform: perspective(180px) rotateY(-76deg) rotate(-11deg) translateY(-1px); }
}
@keyframes flapLeft2 {
  0%,100% { transform: perspective(180px) rotateY(0deg) rotate(-5deg); }
  50% { transform: perspective(180px) rotateY(80deg) rotate(12deg) translateY(-1px); }
}
@keyframes flapRight2 {
  0%,100% { transform: perspective(180px) rotateY(0deg) rotate(5deg); }
  50% { transform: perspective(180px) rotateY(-80deg) rotate(-12deg) translateY(-1px); }
}

@keyframes butterflyFlight1 {
  0% { transform: translate3d(0,0,0) rotate(-8deg); }
  12% { transform: translate3d(8px,-9px,0) rotate(-1deg); }
  28% { transform: translate3d(22px,-17px,0) rotate(8deg); }
  45% { transform: translate3d(36px,-6px,0) rotate(11deg); }
  61% { transform: translate3d(27px,8px,0) rotate(-5deg); }
  78% { transform: translate3d(11px,20px,0) rotate(6deg); }
  91% { transform: translate3d(3px,7px,0) rotate(-7deg); }
  100% { transform: translate3d(0,0,0) rotate(-8deg); }
}
@keyframes butterflyFlight2 {
  0% { transform: translate3d(0,0,0) rotate(9deg); }
  14% { transform: translate3d(-9px,-7px,0) rotate(2deg); }
  30% { transform: translate3d(-23px,-15px,0) rotate(-8deg); }
  47% { transform: translate3d(-38px,-3px,0) rotate(-11deg); }
  63% { transform: translate3d(-26px,10px,0) rotate(6deg); }
  79% { transform: translate3d(-12px,21px,0) rotate(-5deg); }
  92% { transform: translate3d(-3px,8px,0) rotate(7deg); }
  100% { transform: translate3d(0,0,0) rotate(9deg); }
}

@keyframes petalFloat1 { 0%{transform:translate3d(0,-5px,0) rotate(0);opacity:0}12%{opacity:.28}50%{transform:translate3d(17px,28px,0) rotate(48deg);opacity:.22}100%{transform:translate3d(34px,70px,0) rotate(100deg);opacity:0} }
@keyframes petalFloat2 { 0%{transform:translate3d(0,-7px,0) rotate(-10deg);opacity:0}12%{opacity:.24}55%{transform:translate3d(-15px,31px,0) rotate(38deg);opacity:.20}100%{transform:translate3d(-30px,76px,0) rotate(88deg);opacity:0} }
@keyframes petalFloat3 { 0%{transform:translate3d(0,0,0) rotate(8deg);opacity:0}10%{opacity:.20}55%{transform:translate3d(20px,24px,0) rotate(58deg);opacity:.17}100%{transform:translate3d(38px,64px,0) rotate(105deg);opacity:0} }
@keyframes petalFloat4 { 0%{transform:translate3d(0,-3px,0) rotate(-7deg);opacity:0}12%{opacity:.21}52%{transform:translate3d(-19px,22px,0) rotate(42deg);opacity:.17}100%{transform:translate3d(-34px,62px,0) rotate(96deg);opacity:0} }
@keyframes petalFloat5 { 0%{transform:translate3d(0,-4px,0) rotate(3deg);opacity:0}10%{opacity:.18}50%{transform:translate3d(13px,18px,0) rotate(50deg);opacity:.15}100%{transform:translate3d(24px,50px,0) rotate(96deg);opacity:0} }
@keyframes petalFloat6 { 0%{transform:translate3d(0,0,0) rotate(-3deg);opacity:0}10%{opacity:.16}50%{transform:translate3d(-12px,16px,0) rotate(40deg);opacity:.13}100%{transform:translate3d(-22px,46px,0) rotate(84deg);opacity:0} }

@media (max-width: 620px) {
  .app {
    padding-left: 6px;
    padding-right: 6px;
  }

  .top {
    grid-template-columns: 42px 1fr 42px;
  }

  .icon-btn {
    width: 40px;
    height: 40px;
    font-size: 18px;
  }

  .scene {
    min-height: calc(100vh - 92px);
    padding: 48px 0 12px;
  }

  .table-shell {
    width: min(84vw, 500px);
  }

  .result-pill {
    top: 6px;
    min-width: 190px;
    padding: 8px 12px 9px;
  }

  .die-hit {
    width: 88px;
    height: 88px;
  }

  .b1 { width: 38px; height: 48px; left: 8%; top: 23%; }
  .b2 { width: 42px; height: 52px; right: 7%; top: 28%; }
  .p1 { width:16px;height:14px;left:9%;top:19%; }
  .p2 { width:14px;height:12px;left:79%;top:23%; }
  .p3 { width:17px;height:15px;left:5%;top:49%; }
  .p4 { width:13px;height:12px;left:86%;top:48%; }
  .p5 { width:15px;height:14px;left:21%;top:67%; }
  .p6 { width:12px;height:11px;left:72%;top:72%; }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .garden-canopy, .garden-butterfly, .petal-sprite, .scene-foreground {
    animation: none !important;
  }
}


.icon-btn, .deck, .done { transition: transform .18s ease, box-shadow .25s ease, background-color .35s ease; }
.icon-btn:hover, .icon-btn:focus-visible { transform: translateY(-1px); box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(0,0,0,.28); }
.icon-btn:active, .done:active { transform: translateY(1px) scale(.98); }
.icon-btn:focus-visible, .deck:focus-visible, .die-hit:focus-visible, .done:focus-visible, .setting-action:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #fff4bd; outline-offset:4px; }
.deck:hover .deck-card { transform:translateY(-3px); }
.deck.selected:hover .deck-card { transform:translateY(7px) scale(1.18); }
.question-layer[aria-hidden="false"] .question-card { animation:cardEnter .28s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1); }
@keyframes cardEnter { from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(14px) scale(.97)} to{opacity:1;transform:none} }
.question-card { border-color:var(--accent); background:linear-gradient(150deg,#fffaf0,color-mix(in srgb,var(--accent-soft) 72%,#f3e3c7)); }
.settings-layer { position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:55;display:none;place-items:center;padding:20px;background:rgba(17,25,18,.58);backdrop-filter:blur(8px); }
.settings-layer.show { display:grid; }
.settings-card { width:min(92vw,430px);border:3px solid var(--accent);border-radius:26px;padding:26px;background:linear-gradient(150deg,#fffaf0,#eadcc2);box-shadow:0 28px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.44); }
.settings-card h2 { margin:0 0 18px;text-align:center;color:var(--accent-deep);font-size:28px; }
.setting-row { display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:18px;padding:14px 0;border-top:1px solid rgba(75,51,30,.17);font:700 17px Georgia,serif; }
.setting-row:first-of-type { border-top:0; }
.setting-action { border:0;border-radius:999px;padding:10px 17px;background:var(--accent-deep);color:#fff8e7;font:700 15px Georgia,serif;cursor:pointer; }
body.motion-off .scene-foreground, body.motion-off .garden-canopy, body.motion-off .garden-butterfly, body.motion-off .petal-sprite { animation-play-state:paused!important; }
@media (max-height:720px) and (orientation:landscape) { .app{padding-top:8px}.scene{padding-top:38px}.table-shell{width:min(64vh,520px)}.title{font-size:24px}.cute{font-size:16px} }


body{background:#203321}
.app{width:min(100%,980px);padding:18px 14px;min-height:100svh;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.table-art{position:fixed;inset:0;background:#203321 var(--table-art) center/cover no-repeat;z-index:0;transition:opacity .7s}
body.reading .table-art{opacity:0}
.top{flex:none}.title{color:#fff4d7;font-size:clamp(24px,4vw,42px);line-height:1.12;text-shadow:0 3px 10px #000}.title br{display:none}.cute{color:#f1d7a1;font-size:clamp(16px,2vw,22px)}
.scene{min-height:0;flex:1;padding:38px 0 72px;display:grid;place-items:center}
.table-shell{width:min(83vw,68svh,680px);margin:0;perspective:1400px}
.table{border:0;background:transparent;box-shadow:none;transform:none!important}.table::after,.center-ring{display:none}
.deck{width:23%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%) rotate(var(--tilt));filter:drop-shadow(0 12px 8px #160c0aa8)}
.deck.roots{left:50%;top:16%;--tilt:0deg;--card-index:0%}.deck.field{left:19%;top:42%;--tilt:-22deg;--card-index:25%}.deck.garden{left:81%;top:42%;--tilt:22deg;--card-index:50%}.deck.vine{left:30%;top:79%;--tilt:22deg;--card-index:75%}.deck.seasons{left:70%;top:79%;--tilt:-22deg;--card-index:100%}
.deck-card{aspect-ratio:2/3;border-radius:12px;border:1px solid #b89f70!important;background:var(--cards-art) var(--card-index) center/500% 100%!important;box-shadow:0 3px #dbc398,0 5px #776044,0 8px #d8bf92,0 10px #725b3f,0 13px #c4ab80,0 17px 15px #10090580}
.deck-card::before,.deck-card::after,.deck-icon,.deck-name{display:none}
.deck.selected .deck-card{transform:translateY(-7px);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #fff5bb,0 0 22px #ffd46d,0 4px #ddc9a7,0 8px #9d7c4b,0 12px #d4b68b,0 20px 20px #0007}
.deck.selected:hover .deck-card{transform:translateY(-10px)}.table.has-selection .deck:not(.selected){opacity:1;filter:none}
.die-hit{width:160px;height:160px;max-width:34vw;max-height:34vw}
.roll-button{position:absolute;bottom:4px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);padding:12px 45px;border-radius:45px;border:2px solid #ead8ac;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 3px #44543a,0 6px 12px #0009;background:linear-gradient(#435538,#1c2b1e);color:#fff8e5;font:700 clamp(20px,3vw,28px) Georgia;cursor:pointer;white-space:nowrap}
.result-pill{top:0;min-width:150px;padding:5px 16px;background:#fff2dbe8;border-width:1px}.result-pill strong{font-size:18px}.result-pill small{font-size:14px}
body.reading .app{opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .3s}.app{transition:opacity .35s}
.question-layer{background:none;backdrop-filter:none;perspective:1600px;padding:16px;overflow:hidden}
.question-card{position:relative;padding:0;width:min(86vw,420px);height:min(76svh,630px);min-height:0;border:0;background:transparent;box-shadow:none;transform-style:preserve-3d}
.card-face-front,.card-face-back{position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:22px;backface-visibility:hidden;-webkit-backface-visibility:hidden;border:3px solid #b89c65;box-shadow:0 2px #ecd6ae,0 5px #927449,0 28px 65px #17201270}
.card-face-front{display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;align-items:center;padding:28px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#fffbef,var(--accent-soft));outline:1px solid #ae986a;outline-offset:-12px;overflow:auto;transform:translateZ(1px)}
.card-face-back{transform:rotateY(180deg);background:var(--cards-art) var(--card-index) center/500% 100%}
.qtext{font-size:clamp(21px,3.8vw,30px);line-height:1.42;margin:24px 0}.done{font-size:16px}.qcat{font-size:16px}
.question-layer[aria-hidden="false"] .question-card{animation:drawFromStack 1s cubic-bezier(.22,.7,.24,1) both}
@keyframes drawFromStack{0%{transform:translate(var(--launch-x),var(--launch-y)) scale(var(--launch-scale)) rotateY(180deg) rotateZ(var(--launch-turn))}35%{transform:translate(calc(var(--launch-x)*.4),calc(var(--launch-y)*.4 - 35px)) scale(.65) rotateY(165deg) rotateZ(-3deg)}100%{transform:translate(0,0) scale(1) rotateY(0) rotateZ(0)}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.question-layer[aria-hidden="false"] .question-card{animation:none}.layer,.app,.table-art{transition:none}}
@media(max-height:520px) and (orientation:landscape){.table-shell{width:65svh}.scene{padding:10px 0 50px}.cute{display:none}.roll-button{padding:8px 30px}.result-pill{left:10%;top:20%}.card-face-front{padding:18px}.qtext{font-size:18px;margin:14px 0}}
